desc: GitHub #63: fast-forward on a screen that holds its frames to the display's rate (the Steam Deck's): $TTYD_FF_TEST_DRAW=4 shows a frame of every 4 game frames, the others undrawn, as a held-back screen at 4x now does. Mario walks left and runs right, 60 game frames each: he and Goombella reach the same places after the same game frames as in gh63_ff_walk, so 4 times as far a frame shown (before the fix the game ran one frame per frame shown and he kept 1x)
log_must: ^\[speed\] test: a frame shown of every 4 game frames
^\[input\] where: map 'gor_01', Mario at -60 0 -?0,.* motion 1, pose M_W_1
^\[input\] where: map 'gor_01', Mario at 75 0 0,.* motion 2, pose M_R_1
